author: Trunelight
quote: Despite over a 13 years of hype, Grand Theft Auto VI feels more like a tedious realism simulator than a fun sandbox, bogged down by sluggish movement, mandatory daily chores like eating and working out, and rigid, "on-rails" missions that punish creativity. It is a rough game to play as the 30 FPS cap frequently stutters into the low 20s during chaotic shootouts alongside immersion-breaking bugs and clipping issues. While Vice City looks pretty nice, the padded pacing, hit-or-miss satire, and overly restrictive gameplay mechanics make the actual moment-to-moment experience feel like a step backward from the chaotic freedom that made this series so fun.
